items.name: ReStory: Chill Electronics Repairs

Talk to customers, hear their stories, and see how your decisions impact both their lives and your shop.

items.name: over the hill

items.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
items.sub: Lavaflame2 · Idler, Free to Play, Incremental
items.desc: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

items.name: Touhou Koumakyou: New Classic - the Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
items.sub: 上海アリス幻樂団 · Action
items.desc: Dodge the barrage, defeat the enemies, and brave the Scarlet Mist Incident. The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil returns with fresh music and graphics. Control the shrine maiden Reimu and the magician Marisa, weaving between bullets that fill up the screen. The soundtrack has been fully remade by ZUN.

items.name: QuestAway
items.sub: ART X GAMES · Idler, RPG, Trading
items.desc: A tiny idle RPG that lives next to your taskbar. Build a party of heroes, send them off to fight and get back to work. There's loot waiting when you come back. Twelve times a day, everyone takes on a giant Colossus together.

items.name: Sephiria
items.sub: TEAM HORAY · Multiplayer, Action Roguelike, Inventory Management
items.desc: Save Bunnyville from a doomed fate: a top-down action/RPG roguelite from the makers of Dungreed. Explore the depths of the tower, collect and upgrade artifacts, and defeat hordes of demons to keep your village safe.

items.name: Godius Eternal War
items.desc: A classic 2D pixel MMORPG inspired by the golden age of online RPGs. Join nation wars, explore an open multiplayer world, trade with players, battle in PvP, and experience a community-driven adventure that has continued since 1999.

items.name: Glyphica: Typing Survival
items.sub: aliasBLACK · Early Access, Typing, Action Roguelike
items.desc: Weaponize your WPM. Glyphica: Typing Survival is a single-player roguelite horde survival game that lets you mow down hordes of enemies in a minimalistic arena using your finger dexterity, your choice of weapons loadout, and sheer determination.

items.name: Sandustry
items.sub: Lantto Games · Simulation, Strategy, Early Access
items.desc: Explore and mine fully destructible worlds. Automate increasingly complex production chains. Delve deep to uncover an ancient civilization’s powerful secrets and learn to love the sand in this factory game where every pixel is a valuable resource.

items.name: BlazBlue Entropy Effect
items.desc: Enjoy action-packed flashy combat with incredibly satisfying combos and responsive controls! Numerous characters, each with completely unique playstyles and loads of unlockable moves & upgrades! This action roguelike sets the bar for fluid fast-paced action.

items.name: Rubinite
items.desc: Rubinite is an extremely challenging boss rush action game. in a dark fairy tale world, use Ruby's crimson eyes to expose the weak points of the Bloodstained monsters, then strike and shatter them. Carve a road home through the ruined Scarlet Kingdom and face the Witch who took it all.

items.name: IRON NEST: Heavy Turret Simulator
items.desc: IRON NEST is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows ⟹ Will you obey High Command, Operator?

items.name: Dice Tiny Town
items.desc: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

items.name: Mole & Ore
items.desc: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

items.name: GhostomVillage
items.desc: Death has brought you to the Underworld. To avoid fading into oblivion, you must fight to survive. Hunt, farm, fight, build, and trade as you slowly carve out a place for yourself in Netherworld Village. Seek a way to reincarnate—or stay behind and build a life of your own.

items.name: Infinite Loop: Incremental
items.desc: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

items.name: Desktop Divinity
items.desc: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.
